    document.head.appendChild(style);

    const niceStep=(span,target=5)=>{ if(!(span>0))return 1; const raw=span/Math.max(target,1), power=10**Math.floor(Math.log10(raw)), n=raw/power; const nice=n<=1?1:n<=2?2:n<=2.5?2.5:n<=5?5:10; return nice*power; };
    const niceTicks=(min,max,target=5)=>{ if(!finite(min)||!finite(max))return[]; if(min===max)return[min]; const step=niceStep(max-min,target), start=Math.floor(min/step)*step, end=Math.ceil(max/step)*step, out=[]; for(let v=start;v<=end+step*0.2;v+=step)out.push(Math.abs(v)<1e-10?0:v); return out; };
    const frame=(svg,{width,height,left=64,right=24,top=18,bottom=48,xTicks=[],yTicks=[],xScale,yScale,xFmt=v=>String(v),yFmt=v=>String(v),xTitle='',yTitle=''})=>{
      const x0=left,x1=width-right,y0=height-bottom,y1=top;
      yTicks.forEach(v=>{const y=yScale(v);svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:x0,y1:y,x2:x1,y2:y,class:'chart-grid'}));svg.appendChild(svgEl('text',{x:x0-7,y:y+3,'text-anchor':'end',class:'chart-tick'},yFmt(v)));});
      xTicks.forEach(t=>{const x=xScale(t.value);svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:x,y1:y1,x2:x,y2:y0,class:'chart-grid'}));svg.appendChild(svgEl('text',{x,y:y0+17,'text-anchor':'middle',class:'chart-tick'},t.label ?? xFmt(t.value)));});
      svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:x0,y1:y0,x2:x1,y2:y0,class:'chart-axis'}));svg.appendChild(svgEl('line',{x1:x0,y1:y1,x2:x0,y2:y0,class:'chart-axis'}));
      if(xTitle)svg.appendChild(svgEl('text',{x:(x0+x1)/2,y:height-5,'text-anchor':'middle',class:'chart-axis-label'},xTitle));
      if(yTitle)svg.appendChild(svgEl('text',{x:14,y:(y0+y1)/2,transform:`rotate(-90 14 ${(y0+y1)/2})`,'text-anchor':'middle',class:'chart-axis-label'},yTitle));
    };

    // 1. Overview title: always reflect the effective completed-month period.
    const overview=section('results-overview');
    if(overview){
      const h1=overview.querySelector('h1');
      if(h1) h1.textContent=`Portfolio Optimization · ${data.run_id}${period?` (${period})`:''}`;
      const old=overview.querySelector('.period-constraint-note'); if(old)old.remove();
      const requested=configMeta.analysis_period||{};
      const effective=coverageMeta.optimization_monthly_returns||{};
      const assetCoverage=coverageMeta.asset_prices||{};
      const reqStart=requested.start?new Date(`${requested.start}T00:00:00`):null;
      const reqEnd=requested.end?new Date(`${requested.end}T00:00:00`):null;
      const effStart=effective.start?new Date(`${effective.start}T00:00:00`):null;
      const effEnd=effective.end?new Date(`${effective.end}T00:00:00`):null;
      const startConstrained=reqStart&&effStart&&(effStart.getFullYear()*12+effStart.getMonth()>reqStart.getFullYear()*12+reqStart.getMonth());
      const reqEndMonthComplete=reqEnd&&reqEnd.getDate()===new Date(reqEnd.getFullYear(),reqEnd.getMonth()+1,0).getDate();
      const endConstrained=reqEndMonthComplete&&effEnd&&(effEnd.getFullYear()*12+effEnd.getMonth()<reqEnd.getFullYear()*12+reqEnd.getMonth());
      if((startConstrained||endConstrained)&&Object.keys(assetCoverage).length){
        const entries=Object.entries(assetCoverage).filter(([,v])=>v&&v.start&&v.end);
        if(entries.length){
          const boundary=startConstrained?'start':'end';
